record.body:
## Evidence

Suite run at 70c4c3e22: 1347 passed, 3 failed in the tmux stage. The same three fail on main without the phase.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked by the required suite gate.

## Follow-up

Fix the tmux tests, or a human changes phase_gate.suite in .canon/config.json.

payload.basis: tests/test_tmux_integration.py prefix_s_opens_a_side_pane, prefix_a_popup_renders_the_pane_repo_dashboard, prefix_a_popup_keys_only_walks_tabs fail identically on main at 13f7b607b and on phase/composer-schema at 70c4c3e22; 1347 other tests pass
payload.claim: required suite fails on main in 3 tmux dashboard tests, unrelated to composer
payload.invalidated_when: the three tests pass on main, or a human changes phase_gate.suite

record.subject: suite-tmux-preexisting
